from pathlib import Path

from pptx import Presentation
from pptx.dml.color import RGBColor
from pptx.enum.shapes import MSO_AUTO_SHAPE_TYPE, MSO_CONNECTOR
from pptx.enum.text import PP_ALIGN, MSO_ANCHOR
from pptx.enum.dml import MSO_LINE_DASH_STYLE
from pptx.util import Inches, Pt


OUTPUT_DIR = Path("/tmp/pico-naked")
OUTPUT_DIR.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

prs = Presentation()
prs.slide_width = Inches(13.333)
prs.slide_height = Inches(7.5)

# Palette
NAVY = RGBColor(15, 25, 44)
INK = RGBColor(20, 28, 42)
CREAM = RGBColor(247, 244, 235)
MINT = RGBColor(115, 214, 177)
CORAL = RGBColor(241, 111, 91)
YELLOW = RGBColor(246, 202, 77)
BLUE = RGBColor(92, 157, 224)
LAVENDER = RGBColor(183, 164, 226)
WHITE = RGBColor(255, 255, 255)
MUTED = RGBColor(177, 189, 202)
PALE_BLUE = RGBColor(221, 235, 246)
PALE_MINT = RGBColor(218, 242, 229)
PALE_CORAL = RGBColor(251, 222, 215)


def rgb(hex_value):
    hex_value = hex_value.lstrip("#")
    return RGBColor(
        int(hex_value[0:2], 16),
        int(hex_value[2:4], 16),
        int(hex_value[4:6], 16),
    )


def add_box(slide, x, y, w, h, fill, line=None, radius=False, transparency=0):
    shape_type = (
        MSO_AUTO_SHAPE_TYPE.ROUNDED_RECTANGLE
        if radius
        else MSO_AUTO_SHAPE_TYPE.RECTANGLE
    )
    shape = slide.shapes.add_shape(
        shape_type, Inches(x), Inches(y), Inches(w), Inches(h)
    )
    shape.fill.solid()
    shape.fill.fore_color.rgb = fill
    shape.fill.transparency = transparency
    shape.line.color.rgb = line if line else fill
    shape.line.width = Pt(0.8)
    return shape


def add_circle(slide, x, y, d, fill, line=None, transparency=0):
    shape = slide.shapes.add_shape(
        MSO_AUTO_SHAPE_TYPE.OVAL, Inches(x), Inches(y), Inches(d), Inches(d)
    )
    shape.fill.solid()
    shape.fill.fore_color.rgb = fill
    shape.fill.transparency = transparency
    shape.line.color.rgb = line if line else fill
    shape.line.width = Pt(1)
    return shape


def add_line(slide, x1, y1, x2, y2, color, width=2, dash=None):
    line = slide.shapes.add_connector(
        MSO_CONNECTOR.STRAIGHT,
        Inches(x1),
        Inches(y1),
        Inches(x2),
        Inches(y2),
    )
    line.line.color.rgb = color
    line.line.width = Pt(width)
    if dash:
        line.line.dash_style = dash
    return line


def add_text(
    slide,
    text,
    x,
    y,
    w,
    h,
    size=18,
    color=INK,
    bold=False,
    font="Microsoft YaHei",
    align=PP_ALIGN.LEFT,
    valign=MSO_ANCHOR.TOP,
    margin=0.04,
):
    box = slide.shapes.add_textbox(Inches(x), Inches(y), Inches(w), Inches(h))
    tf = box.text_frame
    tf.clear()
    tf.word_wrap = True
    tf.margin_left = Inches(margin)
    tf.margin_right = Inches(margin)
    tf.margin_top = Inches(margin)
    tf.margin_bottom = Inches(margin)
    tf.vertical_anchor = valign
    p = tf.paragraphs[0]
    p.alignment = align
    run = p.add_run()
    run.text = text
    run.font.name = font
    run.font.size = Pt(size)
    run.font.bold = bold
    run.font.color.rgb = color
    return box


def add_rich_text(slide, runs, x, y, w, h, size=16, color=INK, align=PP_ALIGN.LEFT):
    box = slide.shapes.add_textbox(Inches(x), Inches(y), Inches(w), Inches(h))
    tf = box.text_frame
    tf.clear()
    tf.word_wrap = True
    tf.margin_left = Inches(0.04)
    tf.margin_right = Inches(0.04)
    tf.margin_top = Inches(0.03)
    tf.margin_bottom = Inches(0.03)
    p = tf.paragraphs[0]
    p.alignment = align
    for content, emphasis, run_color in runs:
        run = p.add_run()
        run.text = content
        run.font.name = "Microsoft YaHei"
        run.font.size = Pt(size)
        run.font.bold = emphasis
        run.font.color.rgb = run_color if run_color else color
    return box


def add_label(slide, text, x, y, w, fill, color=INK):
    add_box(slide, x, y, w, 0.31, fill, fill, radius=True)
    add_text(
        slide,
        text,
        x,
        y + 0.01,
        w,
        0.25,
        size=10,
        color=color,
        bold=True,
        align=PP_ALIGN.CENTER,
        valign=MSO_ANCHOR.MIDDLE,
    )


def add_title(slide, kicker, title, subtitle=None, dark=True):
    title_color = CREAM if dark else INK
    kicker_color = MINT if dark else CORAL
    add_text(
        slide,
        kicker.upper(),
        0.72,
        0.48,
        3.0,
        0.3,
        size=10,
        color=kicker_color,
        bold=True,
    )
    add_text(
        slide,
        title,
        0.7,
        0.82,
        8.9,
        0.7,
        size=29,
        color=title_color,
        bold=True,
    )
    if subtitle:
        add_text(
            slide,
            subtitle,
            0.74,
            1.54,
            8.8,
            0.38,
            size=12,
            color=MUTED if dark else rgb("657080"),
        )


def add_footer(slide, number, dark=True):
    color = rgb("566477") if dark else rgb("B9C0C8")
    add_text(
        slide,
        f"{number:02d} / 05",
        11.95,
        7.08,
        0.7,
        0.22,
        size=9,
        color=color,
        bold=True,
        align=PP_ALIGN.RIGHT,
    )


def draw_chromosome(slide, cx, cy, scale, color, duplicated=True, accent=None):
    arm = 0.29 * scale
    if duplicated:
        add_line(slide, cx - arm, cy - 0.48 * scale, cx + arm, cy + 0.48 * scale, color, 6)
        add_line(slide, cx + arm, cy - 0.48 * scale, cx - arm, cy + 0.48 * scale, color, 6)
        add_circle(slide, cx - 0.055, cy - 0.055, 0.11, accent if accent else color)
    else:
        add_line(slide, cx, cy - 0.45 * scale, cx, cy + 0.45 * scale, color, 6)


def draw_cell(slide, x, y, d, membrane=WHITE, nucleus=NAVY, chromosome_colors=None):
    chromosome_colors = chromosome_colors or [CORAL, MINT]
    add_circle(slide, x, y, d, membrane, line=rgb("C9D1D9"))
    add_circle(
        slide,
        x + d * 0.22,
        y + d * 0.22,
        d * 0.56,
        nucleus,
        line=nucleus,
        transparency=5,
    )
    draw_chromosome(
        slide,
        x + d * 0.43,
        y + d * 0.46,
        d * 0.6,
        chromosome_colors[0],
        duplicated=True,
    )
    draw_chromosome(
        slide,
        x + d * 0.57,
        y + d * 0.52,
        d * 0.52,
        chromosome_colors[1],
        duplicated=True,
    )


def draw_dividing_cell(slide, x, y, d, stage=1, left_color=CORAL, right_color=MINT):
    add_circle(slide, x, y, d, WHITE, line=rgb("C9D1D9"))
    center_x = x + d / 2
    center_y = y + d / 2
    if stage == 1:
        draw_chromosome(slide, center_x - 0.16, center_y, d * 0.58, left_color, True)
        draw_chromosome(slide, center_x + 0.16, center_y, d * 0.5, right_color, True)
    elif stage == 2:
        add_line(slide, x + 0.16, center_y, x + d - 0.16, center_y, rgb("CBD4DF"), 1, MSO_LINE_DASH_STYLE.DASH)
        draw_chromosome(slide, center_x - 0.17, center_y, d * 0.5, left_color, True)
        draw_chromosome(slide, center_x + 0.17, center_y, d * 0.5, right_color, True)
    else:
        add_line(slide, center_x, y + 0.14, center_x, y + d - 0.14, rgb("CBD4DF"), 1, MSO_LINE_DASH_STYLE.DASH)
        draw_chromosome(slide, center_x - 0.18, center_y - 0.14, d * 0.37, left_color, False)
        draw_chromosome(slide, center_x + 0.18, center_y + 0.14, d * 0.37, right_color, False)


def add_arrow(slide, x, y, w, color=YELLOW):
    add_line(slide, x, y, x + w - 0.12, y, color, 2.5)
    add_line(slide, x + w - 0.12, y, x + w - 0.27, y - 0.1, color, 2.5)
    add_line(slide, x + w - 0.12, y, x + w - 0.27, y + 0.1, color, 2.5)

# Large right-side cell illustration
add_circle(slide, 8.1, 1.18, 3.55, rgb("263956"), line=MINT)
add_circle(slide, 8.58, 1.66, 2.59, rgb("1B2944"), line=rgb("46617E"))
draw_chromosome(slide, 9.65, 3.0, 1.4, CORAL, True, YELLOW)

add_text(slide, "DNA复制", 7.05, 5.96, 1.1, 0.24, size=11, color=CREAM, bold=True)

# Slide 2: core logic
slide = prs.slides.add_slide(prs.slide_layouts[6])

# Three visual steps
steps = [
    (0.78, "01", "复制一次", "染色体先复制\n姐妹染色单体相连", PALE_CORAL, CORAL),
    (4.56, "02", "分裂两次", "第一次分开同源染色体\n第二次分开姐妹染色单体", PALE_MINT, rgb("1D9B70")),
    (8.34, "03", "得到四个", "4 个细胞\n染色体数目减半", PALE_BLUE, BLUE),
]
for x, num, heading, body, fill, accent in steps:
    add_box(slide, x, 2.35, 3.1, 3.22, fill, line=fill, radius=True)
    add_circle(slide, x + 0.26, 2.61, 0.56, accent)
    add_text(slide, num, x + 0.26, 2.72, 0.56, 0.2, size=12, color=WHITE, bold=True, align=PP_ALIGN.CENTER)
    add_text(slide, heading, x + 0.28, 3.42, 2.52, 0.4, size=21, color=INK, bold=True)
    add_text(slide, body, x + 0.3, 4.13, 2.45, 0.78, size=13, color=rgb("566171"))
    if num == "01":
        draw_chromosome(slide, x + 1.52, 5.05, 0.62, CORAL, True, YELLOW)
    elif num == "02":
        add_circle(slide, x + 1.18, 4.85, 0.7, WHITE, line=rgb("9EDCC3"))
        add_circle(slide, x + 1.97, 4.85, 0.7, WHITE, line=rgb("9EDCC3"))
        draw_chromosome(slide, x + 1.53, 5.2, 0.34, CORAL, False)
    else:
        for ix in range(4):
            add_circle(slide, x + 0.64 + (ix % 2) * 1.02, 4.72 + (ix // 2) * 0.53, 0.38, WHITE, line=BLUE)
            draw_chromosome(slide, x + 0.83 + (ix % 2) * 1.02, 4.91 + (ix // 2) * 0.53, 0.23, MINT if ix % 2 else CORAL, False)

add_arrow(slide, 3.99, 3.82, 0.42, CORAL)
add_arrow(slide, 7.77, 3.82, 0.42, CORAL)

add_box(slide, 0.78, 6.13, 10.65, 0.58, INK, INK, radius=True)
add_rich_text(
    slide,
    [("关键结论  ", True, YELLOW), ("2n", True, MINT), ("  →  ", True, WHITE), ("n + n + n + n", True, CORAL), ("   染色体数目减半，但遗传组合更丰富", False, WHITE)],
    1.03,
    6.29,
    10.1,
    0.25,
    size=13,
)
add_footer(slide, 2, dark=False)

# Main diagram
add_box(slide, 0.72, 2.25, 7.35, 3.72, rgb("1B2A45"), line=rgb("334A68"), radius=True)
add_text(slide, "一条细胞的旅程", 1.02, 2.54, 2.2, 0.3, size=13, color=MINT, bold=True)

stage_x = [1.02, 2.65, 4.28, 5.91]

    add_text(slide, label, x, 3.03, 1.2, 0.25, size=11, color=CREAM, bold=True, align=PP_ALIGN.CENTER)
    if i == 0:
        draw_dividing_cell(slide, x, 3.42, 1.1, stage=1)
    elif i == 1:
        draw_dividing_cell(slide, x, 3.42, 1.1, stage=2)
    elif i == 2:
        draw_dividing_cell(slide, x, 3.42, 1.1, stage=3)
    else:
        add_circle(slide, x + 0.03, 3.52, 0.48, WHITE, line=rgb("C9D1D9"))
        add_circle(slide, x + 0.59, 3.52, 0.48, WHITE, line=rgb("C9D1D9"))
        draw_chromosome(slide, x + 0.27, 3.76, 0.32, CORAL, True)
        draw_chromosome(slide, x + 0.83, 3.76, 0.32, MINT, True)
    if i < 3:
        add_arrow(slide, x + 1.2, 3.97, 0.35, YELLOW)

# Annotation rail
add_box(slide, 1.03, 5.12, 6.74, 0.48, rgb("233653"), line=rgb("233653"), radius=True)

# Four outputs

# Slide 5: comparison and recap
slide = prs.slides.add_slide(prs.slide_layouts[6])
add_box(slide, 0, 0, 13.333, 7.5, INK)

# Comparison table-like layout
add_box(slide, 0.75, 2.35, 7.55, 3.65, rgb("25344F"), line=rgb("364C68"), radius=True)
add_box(slide, 0.75, 2.35, 2.28, 0.62, rgb("35A17C"), line=rgb("35A17C"))

rows = [
    ("分裂次数", "1 次", "2 次"),
    ("子细胞数量", "2 个", "4 个"),
    ("染色体数目", "保持不变", "减半"),
    ("遗传结果", "基本相同", "存在差异"),
]
for i, (label, mitosis, meiosis) in enumerate(rows):
    y = 2.97 + i * 0.75
    fill = rgb("1E2D47") if i % 2 == 0 else rgb("223653")
    add_box(slide, 0.75, y, 7.55, 0.75, fill, line=fill)
    add_text(slide, label, 1.02, y + 0.25, 1.68, 0.22, size=12, color=rgb("C5D0DC"), bold=True)
    add_text(slide, mitosis, 3.36, y + 0.25, 1.85, 0.22, size=12, color=CREAM)
    add_text(slide, meiosis, 6.05, y + 0.25, 1.9, 0.22, size=12, color=YELLOW if i > 1 else MINT, bold=i > 1)

# Final takeaway panel
add_box(slide, 8.75, 2.35, 3.83, 3.65, CREAM, line=CREAM, radius=True)
add_text(slide, "带走三句话", 9.12, 2.7, 2.6, 0.34, size=20, color=INK, bold=True)
takeaways = [
    ("01", "复制一次"),
    ("02", "分裂两次"),
    ("03", "产生变异组合"),
]
for i, (n, statement) in enumerate(takeaways):
    y = 3.48 + i * 0.68
    add_circle(slide, 9.12, y, 0.38, [CORAL, MINT, BLUE][i])
    add_text(slide, n, 9.12, y + 0.09, 0.38, 0.16, size=9, color=WHITE, bold=True, align=PP_ALIGN.CENTER)
    add_text(slide, statement, 9.72, y + 0.05, 2.2, 0.25, size=14, color=INK, bold=True)

add_box(slide, 8.98, 5.3, 3.35, 0.08, CORAL)
add_text(slide, "为有性生殖准备单倍体配子", 9.12, 5.55, 2.9, 0.28, size=12, color=rgb("657080"), bold=True)

add_text(slide, "2n  →  n", 0.82, 6.62, 2.2, 0.42, size=24, color=YELLOW, bold=True)
add_text(slide, "染色体数目减半，遗传组合增加", 3.02, 6.73, 4.4, 0.22, size=12, color=rgb("B9C6D4"))
add_text(slide, "END", 11.8, 6.73, 0.72, 0.22, size=10, color=MUTED, bold=True, align=PP_ALIGN.RIGHT)
add_footer(slide, 5)


prs.save("/tmp/pico-naked/naked_meiosis.pptx")
